page.layout: One printed page (right page of an opening). Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text in one column with a large woodcut initial at the start. Table of numbers in the middle of the text block. Left edge shows part of the facing page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.l: ANTVM de proportione A-
rithmetica: sequitur Geometrica, quae
est rationum aequalitas.
Τῶν λόγων ταυτότης ἐν ὅροις. Verum hic Ratio-
nis uox non generaliter, sed uoce specifica sumitur, pro
quotorum aequalitate, quae inter comparatos numeros
cernitur. Vt in 2.6.4.12, quae ratio est inter 2 & 6,
eadem inter 4 & 12, utrobiq; subtripla. Si uero quatuor
numeri directè fuerint proportionales: idem etiam inuerse
& alterne, ac caeteris item proportionis modis Logicis,
proportionales erunt. 16 d. 5, & 13 p.7. cum ea-
dem consectariis, in hunc modum:
2 | 6 | 4 | 12 | Directè
6 | 2 | 12 | 4 | Inuersè
2 | 4 | 6 | 12 | Alternè.
Est autem haec quoq; duplex, Disiunc-
ta scilicet, & Continua.
Disiuncta est, quae neque terminis,
neq; rationibus cohaeret.
Vt in 6 3 16 8, hic enim duae duplae sunt, & ter-
minis distinctae, & rationibus, eò quod inter 3 & 16 eadem
ratio non seruetur, quae inter 6 & 3, atque inter
Disiuncta in quatuor ad minimùm ter-
minis consistit.
F 4 Pro-

page.notes: Left margin partly holds text of the facing page (e.g. "IV.", "CAP. XV.", "CAP. XVI.", "Geometrica", "Arithmetica"), which is not transcribed. Greek line and table cells are as read; the woodcut initial is an A decorated letter, read as "A". The signature line "F 4 Pro-" is a catchword-like mark at the foot and is given as printed text.
